title: Opportunities for Entrepreneurship in Electrical sector

photo.alt: Opportunities for Entrepreneurship in Electrical sector

summary: Our country is growing at a scorching pace despite the prevailing head winds.
description:
Our country is growing at a scorching pace despite the prevailing head winds. Our industry has doubtless played a pivotal role in the growth story of the Nation, aided, doubtless, by the Government's push for an Atmanirbhar Bharat. And, as the name itself justifiably suggests, the Electrical sector plays an inherently key role in the development of industry as a whole, across all sectors.
Little wonder then, our own PP Rtn Manish Gyani, a veteran Electrical Engineer and a reputed Industrialist, aptly chose to speak on the Opportunities of Entrepreneurship in the Electrical Sector, while delivering his scintillating lecture to the students (and their parents) at an Entrepreneurship Awareness Seminar held on 27th August at the Ava Elma Institute Of Skill Vocational And Training, Kandivli. His lecture, held under the auspices of RCB, detailed the functionalities of Electrical Engineering across various sectors, and the opportunities available for budding entrepreneurs in this highly skilled profession. He spoke with depth and erudition on the topic bringing to fore his four decades long experience in this field. The students, their parents and the faculty listened to him with rapt attention, and accorded him a thumping applause at the end of the session. The Principal of the Institute thanked Rtn Manish Gyani for his inspirational talk, and also thanked RCB President Rtn Aarti Parekh as well as RCB's Vocational Director Rtn Rahul Bamb for their involvement in this extremely fruitful event.
Verily, great oak trees grow from tiny acorns.
